args.request: 안개 낀 항구 창고의 가방 팝업. 밧줄과 녹슨 체인 사이로 등대 불빛이 천천히 지나간다.
args.theme: An atmospheric bag pop-up in a foggy harbor warehouse where a lighthouse beam slowly sweeps through hanging ropes and rusted chains.
args.hero_idea: lighthouse beam sweeping across hanging bags

notes: brand 'gentleMonster' is not in the request text passed; kept -- check it is the user's
dome: used the plan's own shape/material/label (zone, concrete, Under the dome) -- the role was not given
pay: used the plan's own shape (box)

args.synopsis: You step into the heavy, salt-touched air of a dim warehouse where fog rolls across the floor. In the center, the rotating lighthouse lamp pulses with a rhythmic glow, its beam carving paths through the darkness to illuminate the bags arranged on rugged, weathered shelves. You move through the shadows, tracing the lines of ropes and chains before reaching the final transaction point, hidden away like a cargo manifest in the back. Each turn reveals a new perspective of the bags, caught between the stillness of the warehouse and the persistent light of the distant beacon.

why.d: creates an immersive sense of an industrial, fog-filled environment that defines the store's boundary.
acts as a silent, moving focal point that draws you into the space.
structures the movement through the shop to prioritize the hero display.
concludes your experience in a space that feels like the end of a long voyage.

args.line: A spectral beacon cuts through the heavy air, guiding you through a collection of bags anchored in a forgotten harbor.
args.quote: Where the light meets the shore, silence defines the weight of the journey.
args.subtitle: A lighthouse beacon illuminating the fog-bound harbor warehouse.
args.title: Harbor Fog Warehouse

stops.cap: I step into the thick fog and the lighthouse beam catches my eye immediately.
stops.sub: A steady, rhythmic pulse in the dark warehouse.
Traces of nautical ropes pull my gaze toward the walls.
stops.cap: Moving through the aisles, the bags sit heavy and grounded against the aged wood.
I finish my journey at the dark stone counter at the very back of the warehouse.
stops.sub: The quiet end of a journey through the fog.
